corsAllowedOrigins.description:
Browser origins allowed to read objects through signed URLs.

When non-empty, providers configure CORS for `GET` and `HEAD` requests.
An origin of `*` is appropriate for private buckets whose signed URLs
are bearer credentials and do not use browser cookies.
Default: `[]` (CORS disabled).

oneOf.description: Customer-managed Key used by the provider's native storage encryption.

type.description: Resource type identifier that determines the specific kind of resource. This field is used for polymorphic deserialization and resource-specific behavior.

id.description:
Name of the the storage bucket.
For names with dots, each dot-separated label must be ≤ 63 characters.

items.description: Defines a rule for managing the lifecycle of objects within a storage bucket.

days.description: Number of days after which objects matching the rule expire.

prefix.description: Optional prefix to filter objects the rule applies to. If None, applies to all objects.

lifecycleRules.description:
List of rules for automatic object management (e.g., expiration).
Default: `[]` (empty list)

items.description:
Delivers matching object events to a queue in the same stack.
Overlapping rules each deliver a message; consumers must tolerate duplicates.
Object events that can be delivered to a queue.

events.description: Events to deliver. Defaults to object creation; v1 supports only `created`.

prefix.description: Literal object key prefix, non-empty and at most 512 UTF-8 bytes when set.

queue.description: Target Queue. It must have the same lifecycle as the Storage.

type.description: Resource type identifier that determines the specific kind of resource. This field is used for polymorphic deserialization and resource-specific behavior.

suffix.description: Literal object key suffix, non-empty and at most 512 UTF-8 bytes when set.

notifications.description:
Object notification rules delivered into queues (at most 10).
Omitted when empty to preserve existing serialized configurations and setup digests.

publicRead.description:
Allows public read access to objects without authentication.
Default: `false`
